source.prompt: A California scrub-jay (Aphelocoma californica), one adult bird perched with its wings folded tight against the body, side-on pose. Realistic proportions, about 29 cm long with a long tail half the body length. Crestless flat crown. Bright blue head, wings and tail; grey-brown patch on the back; dark grey cheek with a thin white eyebrow; white streaked throat bordered by a partial blue breast band; pale grey-white belly. Stout straight black bill, long black legs, three toes forward and one back. No base, no perch. Game-ready, clean closed mesh.

candidates.review: Reads as a slim, crestless jay: flat crown with only a tiny nape nub, wings folded tight along the back (body 0.41 units wide against 1.9 long, about 6 cm at true scale), long graduated tail about half the total length with a notched tip, long black-jay legs with three forward toes and a hind toe, eye socket with a brow. One closed, manifold piece (no boundary or non-manifold edges after welding), 1.3% slivers. Faults: the bill is slender and a little long (about 0.75-0.8 of the head, near the brief's limit) and lacks the stout base, so it edges toward thrasher or grackle; the tail is narrow in plan; feet are flat rather than curled for a twig. No blue-jay bias in the geometry (no crest). A build script would sand the nape nub, thicken the bill base slightly, cut the tail free at its base and tag it TAIL, and replace the feet below mid-tarsus with curled procedural toes.

accuracy_notes: Adopted 2026-10-25 from the Meshy preview. Reads as a slim, crestless, long-tailed jay at 3-10 m, blue head with a white throat and the blue necklace, grey-brown mantle between blue wings; far better than buildJay. Still open: the ear patch and white brow are only a few faces at lod0 and vanish at lod1; the throat streaking is a sparse face mottle; the bill is still a little long; the wing cards are flat planes (no slotted primaries); no juvenile (grey-headed) variant; no acorn in the bill when caching. A local birder should check bill depth and tail length.
